oneTimers.text: GAAP operating income fell 35% to $109M (a 10% margin) as Akamai spends ahead of its cloud build-out. Non-GAAP operating income was $286M (25% margin) — the $177M gap is mostly stock compensation and amortization.

segments.name: Security
segments.note: Web app/API protection, zero-trust and anti-DDoS — now 55% of revenue and still growing 9%.

segments.name: Delivery & other cloud apps
segments.note: The original content-delivery business — still huge, but shrinking 3% as media traffic pricing grinds down.

segments.name: Cloud Infrastructure Services
segments.note: The growth bet: compute, storage and AI inference on Akamai's edge. Up 34% — small today, guided to $1.1–1.3B of revenue in 2027.

takeaways.text: Akamai has signed more than $14B of multi-year Cloud Infrastructure commitments this year — the backlog behind its claim that 2027 revenue growth jumps to 17–22% and 2028 revenue tops $7.0B.
takeaways.title: The backlog is the headline

takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin compressed to 10% (from 16%) — the cost of building a cloud business before its revenue arrives. GAAP EPS fell 21% to $0.77.
takeaways.title: Profit is being spent on the pivot

takeaways.text: Security is now the majority of the company and compounding at 9%; legacy delivery shrinks slowly at −3%. The mix shift is nearly complete.
takeaways.title: Security is the core now

verdict: A pivot quarter: today's profit dips (GAAP EPS $0.77) to fund a cloud business with $14B of signed commitments.
